pin.estimand: backfilled from a filed measurement row (metric: token_delta) — no preregistration existed

attempt.note: not a preregistration — record created retroactively so the row is joinable; mint-before-spend evidence does not exist for it

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.population: agent-facing first-person-plural action statements where addressee inclusion is operationally consequential
estimand.baseline: ordinary careful English that explicitly says whether the reader is included in the we-group
estimand.aggregation: equal weight across six operational domains and inclusive/exclusive clusivity strata

design.balance: complete 6 x 2 crossing; one fresh item per cell
design.selection: domains, wording, balance, and equal weights fixed before tokenisation; no item copied from a filed manifest

manifest.method: Use the official ainglish.measure.token_delta harness. For each tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) per pair, take the arithmetic mean, and report the larger tokenizer mean as the registered floor.
manifest.analysis_plan: Report the balanced aggregate and both preregistered clusivity-stratum means regardless of sign. Do not rewrite cells after tokenisation.
manifest.notes: This measures token cost only, not comprehension. The English arm explicitly marks reader inclusion/exclusion; the result does not compare against ambiguous bare we.
